# @vesk/adapter — Machine-Readable Reference (llms.txt)

Source-verified inventory of `packages/adapter/src/*.ts`. All signatures below
were read from the actual source. Anything unverifiable is tagged `[UNVERIFIED]`.
ESM + TypeScript monorepo package; `"type": "module"`; entry `dist/index.js`.

Package: `@vesk/adapter` v0.1.6 — builds deployable `.vesk/` output for Node and
serverless platforms. Public exports from `src/index.ts`: `build`,
`startProdServer` (re-exported).

---

## 1. Function / export inventory (per file)

### `src/index.ts`
- `build(appDir: string, options?: BuildOptions): Promise<BuildResult | undefined>` — full pipeline.
- re-export `export { startProdServer } from '@vesk/adapter/src/prod-server'`.
- internal `resolveCompilerApi<T>(name: string): Promise<T>` — dynamic import of
  `@vesk/compiler/src/<name>` preferring the monorepo `../../compiler/src` when it exists.

### `src/types.ts` (data types only — no functions)
Interfaces: `VeskPlugin`, `VeskSecurity`, `RouteNode`, `ApiRouteNode`,
`MiddlewareChainItem`, `AncestorLayout`, `BuildOptions`, `DevServerOptions`,
`ProdServerOptions`, `SsrFunctionOptions`, `ApiFunctionOptions`,
`ClientBundleOptions`, `ChunkEntry`, `ClientBundleResult`, `ManifestRouteEntry`,
`ManifestActionEntry`, `ManifestPrerenderedEntry`, `Manifest`, `SsgRouteResult`,
`BuildResult`, `ImageRef`, `ImageResult`, `MiddlewareExtractResult`,
`SeoCheckIssue`, `SeoAuditResult`, `CombinedPageInfo`, `SecurityConfig`,
`MonolithicBundleParts`.

Key shapes:
```
BuildOptions { outDir?, publicDir?, plugins?, seo?, strictSeo?, siteUrl?, ssg?, codeSplit?, hmr?, target?: 'node'|'edge', platform?: 'node'|'vercel'|'netlify'|'cloudflare'|'deno'|'aws'|'edge'|'coxmos' }
BuildResult { routeTree: RouteNode[]; apiTree: ApiRouteNode[]; ssrRoutes: RouteNode[]; apiRoutes: ApiRouteNode[]; manifest: Manifest }
ClientBundleResult { main: string; chunks: ChunkEntry[] }   // ChunkEntry { name; code }
Manifest { version: number; middleware: boolean; routes: ManifestRouteEntry[]; prerendered: ManifestPrerenderedEntry[]; static: { prefix; dir }; actions?: ManifestActionEntry[] }
RouteNode { path; fullPath; isGroup; isDynamic; isCatchAll; page; layout; loading; error; notFound; hasMiddleware; children; sourceDir; segmentCount; _revalidate?; _isrTags?; _pageName?; _layoutName?; chunk? }
ApiRouteNode { path; fullPath; isDynamic; isCatchAll; filePath; children }
SsgRouteResult { path; html; static; params? }
VeskPlugin { name; onBuildStart?; onBuildEnd?; onCSS?; [key: string]: unknown }
```

### `src/runtime-bundle.ts`
- `bundleRuntime(appDir: string, outDir: string): Promise<string>` — writes
  `server/runtime.js`, returns its absolute path.
- internal: `findCompilerSrc`, `findRuntimeSrc`, module-level `buildId`.
- The bundle re-exports: `cookies`, `headers`, `locals`, `renderPage`,
  `renderFullPage`, `renderPageStream`, `compileFile`, `parseCookies`,
  `VeskRequest`, `VeskResponse`, `defineAction`, `getAction`, `clearActions`,
  `validateActionInput`, `issuesToFieldMap`.

### `src/ssr-function.ts`
- `generateSsrFunction(routeNode: RouteNode, appDir: string, outDir: string, componentMap?: Map<string,string>, options?: SsrFunctionOptions): { funcPath: string; funcCode: string; name: string }`
  (`SsrFunctionOptions { ancestorLayouts?: AncestorLayout[]; middlewareCode?: string | null }`)
- internal (module-scope, not exported): `escapeSource`, `routeName`,
  `extractCompName` (wraps compiler `resolveComponentName`), `buildParamExtraction`.
- Generated modules define `export async function handle(request)`, and when
  actions are present `registerActions`, `__paramsFor`, `__renderHtml`, and a
  `handleAction` path (lines ~254-308).

### `src/api-function.ts`
- `generateApiFunction(apiNode: ApiRouteNode, _apiDir: string, outDir: string, options?: ApiFunctionOptions): { funcPath: string; funcCode: string; name: string }`
  (`ApiFunctionOptions { middlewareCode?: string | null }`)
- internal: `apiRouteName`.
- Generated modules rewrite `@vesk/runtime` imports to `../runtime.js`, strip TS
  via esbuild `transformSync`, and define `export async function handle(request)`.

### `src/client-bundle.ts`
- `generateClientBundle(routeTree: RouteNode[], appDir: string, componentMap?: Map<string,string>, options?: ClientBundleOptions): Promise<ClientBundleResult>`
  (`ClientBundleOptions { codeSplit?; hmr?; importRuntime? }`)
- `buildRuntimeCode(runtimeDir: string): string` — LEGACY concatenated runtime
  (file-by-file glue with `// --- <file> ---` markers). Not the modern path.
- `runtimeExportNames(runtimeDir: string): Set<string>` — names exported by
  `runtime/index-client.js`.
- `buildTreeShakenRuntime(runtimeDir: string, usedNames: string[]): Promise<string>`
  — esbuild IIFE with `globalName: '__veskRuntime'` + explicit
  `export { ... };`; falls back to `buildRuntimeCode` on any missing name.
- internal: `findRuntimeSrc`, `collectRuntimeImports`, `stripRuntimeImport`,
  `stripVskImports`, `resolveVskImports`, `stripExports`, `compileFile`,
  `buildChunkName`, `compileFileMono`, `walkSplit`, `walkMono`, `stripTypes`,
  `appendHmrGlobals`, `buildMainBundle` (private), module `runtimeEntryId`.

### `src/middleware.ts`
- `compileMiddleware(mwChain: MiddlewareChainItem[], _appDir: string): string | null`
  — emits a standalone chain exporting `execute(ctx)`.
- `compileMiddlewareCode(mwSourceTexts: string[]): string | null` — INLINE
  variant (`__mwChain` + `__executeMw`) used inside SSR/API functions.
- internal: `extractMiddlewareBody` (wraps compiler `extractMiddlewareParts`).

### `src/static.ts`
- `copyStaticAssets(publicDir: string, outDir: string): void`
- `generateSsgRoutes(routeTree: RouteNode[], appDir: string, outDir: string): Promise<SsgRouteResult[]>`
- `generateSitemap(_routeTree: RouteNode[], ssrRoutes: RouteNode[], prerenderedRoutes: SsgRouteResult[], { siteUrl = 'http://localhost:3000' }?: { siteUrl?: string }): string`
- `generateRobotsTxt(siteUrl = 'http://localhost:3000'): string`
- internal: `evaluateExport` (uses `new Function`, regex extraction).

### `src/manifest.ts`
- `generateManifest(routes: RouteNode[], ssrRoutes: RouteNode[], apiRoutes: ApiRouteNode[], staticRoutes: SsgRouteResult[], middlewareEnabled: boolean, actionMap?: Record<string,string>): Manifest`

### `src/image-pipeline.ts`
- `optimizeImages(appDir: string, outDir: string): Promise<ImageResult[]>`
- internal: `processImage`, `collectImageRefs`, module `sharpFn`, consts
  `SUPPORTED`, `OUTPUT_WIDTHS = [640,768,1024,1280,1536]`, `FORMATS = ['webp','avif']`.
- Sharp is optional; without it originals are copied to `-<width>w` files.

### `src/seo-audit.ts`
- `runSeoAudit(appDir: string, _options?: Record<string, unknown>): SeoAuditResult`
  (`SeoAuditResult { passed; errors; warnings }`)
- internal: `walkFiles`, `collectCombinedSource`, `SEO_CHECKS` (h1, altText,
  imageAlt, metaDescription, ogTags, langAttr, title, headingOrder), const `SEVERITY`.


### `src/platform.ts`
- export type `Platform = 'node' | 'vercel' | 'netlify' | 'cloudflare' | 'deno' | 'aws' | 'edge' | 'coxmos'`
- `detectPlatform(args: string[] = [], env: PlatformEnv = process.env as PlatformEnv): Platform`
- `platformLabel(platform: Platform): string`
- internal const `VALID`.

### `src/platform-output.ts`
- export const `MIME: Record<string,string>` — extension → content-type map.
- `ensureCleanDir(dir: string): void`
- `copyDirContents(srcDir: string, destDir: string): void`
- `writeFile(path: string, content: string | Buffer): void`
- `writePlatformStatic(buildStaticDir: string, platformStaticDir: string): void`
  (maps `/_vesk/static/*` ← `.vesk/static/*`, `/_vesk/runtime.js` ←
  `client.js`, `/*` ← `static/public/*`)
- `writePrerenderedStatic(prerenderedRoutes: SsgRouteResult[], platformStaticDir: string): void`
- `listStaticDir(dir: string): Array<{ rel: string; buffer: Buffer }>`
- `mimeFor(path: string): string`

### `src/platform-handler.ts`
- `routeName(segments: string[]): string`
- `apiRouteName(fullPath: string): string`
- `toId(s: string): string`
- `generatePlatformHandlerSource(input: PlatformHandlerInput): string`
  (`PlatformHandlerInput { ssrRoutes; apiRoutes; prerenderedPaths: string[]; hasMiddleware: boolean }`)
  — emits import-based universal handler with `handleRequest(request)`,
  `__matchPath`, `__routes`, `__isrCache`, prerendered 308 redirect.
- `bundlePlatformHandler(options: BundlePlatformOptions): Promise<void>`
  (`BundlePlatformOptions { nodeBuiltins?: boolean; outfile: string; entry: string }`)
- types: `PlatformHandlerInput`, `BundlePlatformOptions`, `PlatformBuildContext`.
- internal: `findCompilerSrc`.

### `src/platform-deploy.ts`
- `emitPlatformOutput(platform: Platform, ctx: DeployContext): Promise<string | null>`
  — returns `null` for `'node'`, an artifact path otherwise. (`DeployContext =
  PlatformBuildContext & { prerenderedRoutes: SsgRouteResult[] }`)
- internal: `Shell` interface; `shellFor(platform)`, `vercelConfigJson`,
  `__relsSource`, `__mimeSource`, `denoStaticSource`, `nodeStaticSource`,
  `inlineStaticSource`.

### `src/prod-server.ts`
- `startProdServer(outDir: string, options?: { port?: number }): Promise<Server>`
- internal: `readBody`, `makeWebRequest`, `MIME`, `matchPath`,
  `getClientIpFromReq`, interfaces `ExtendedRequest`, `BuildConfig`,
  `BuildConfigRoute`, `MatchPathResult`.


### `src/hmr.ts`
- `createHmrServer(httpServer: Server, appDir: string, devDir: string, componentMap?: Map<string,string>): { broadcast: (type: string, data?: Record<string,unknown>) => void; handleFileChange: (filename: string | null, doFullBuild: () => Promise<void>, routeTree: RouteNode[]) => Promise<void> }`
- internal: `findRouteForSource`, `collectAncestorLayouts`,
  `extractComponentAssignments`, `extractSourceDir`, `escapeSource`,
  `extractCompName`, `routeName`, `buildParamExtraction`, `regenerateSsrFunction`.

### `src/dev-server.ts`
- `startDevServer(appDir: string, options?: DevServerOptions): Promise<Server | void>`
  (`DevServerOptions { port?; publicDir?; block? }`)
- internal: `readBody`, `makeWebRequest`, `MIME`, `matchPath`, `ExtendedRequest`,
  and inner `doBuild()` that calls `build(appDir, { outDir: devDir, hmr: true })`.

---

## 2. `build()` step-by-step flow (what each sub-function does)

Call: `build(appDir, options)`. Returns `BuildResult | undefined`.

1. `resolve(appDir)`; `outDir = options.outDir ?? resolve(appDir,'..','.vesk')`;
   `publicDir = options.publicDir ?? resolve(appDir,'..','public')`;
   `plugins = options.plugins ?? []`.
2. Run every `plugin.onBuildStart()` (awaited).
3. `mkdirSync` (`recursive`) for: `server/functions`, `server/api`,
   `static/public`, `prerendered`.
4. `resolveCompilerApi` loads compiler fns: `scanRoutes`, `scanComponents` from
   `router.js`; `scanApiRoutes` from `api-routes.js`; `collectMiddlewareChain`
   from `middleware.js`.
5. `scanRoutes(appDir)` → `routeTree`. If empty → warn + `return undefined`.
6. `projectRoot = resolve(appDir,'..')`; `scanComponents(<project>/components)`
   → `componentMap`.
7. `scanApiRoutes(<project>/app/api)` (only if it exists) → `apiTree`.
8. `bundleRuntime(appDir, outDir)` → `server/runtime.js` (shared by all fns).
9. **SSR pass** — `walk(nodes, ancestorLayouts)`: for each node with `page`:
   - `collectMiddlewareChain(routeTree, node.fullPath, appDir)` → chain;
     read each source; inline via `compileMiddlewareCode(sources)` → `mwCode`.
   - `generateSsrFunction(node, appDir, outDir, componentMap,
     { ancestorLayouts, middlewareCode: mwCode })` → write to
     `server/functions/<name>.js`.
   - `collectActionIds(pageSrc)` (+ layout + ancestor-layout sources) →
     populate `actionMap[id] = 'server/functions/<name>.js'`.
   - parse `export const revalidate = <n>` → `node._revalidate`; parse
     `export const isrTags = [...]` → `node._isrTags`.
   - push node to `ssrRoutes`.
10. **API pass** — `walkApi`: for each node with `filePath`,
    `generateApiFunction(node, apiDir, outDir)` → `server/api/<name>.js`.
11. **Root middleware** — `collectMiddlewareChain(routeTree,'/')` → if any,
    `compileMiddleware(chain, appDir)` writes `server/middleware.js`;
    `middlewareEnabled = true`.
12. `generateClientBundle(routeTree, appDir, componentMap, { codeSplit?, hmr? })`
    → `{ main, chunks }`; write `main` → `static/client.js`; write each chunk →
    `static/<name>.js`.
13. `copyStaticAssets(publicDir, outDir)` → `static/public/`.
14. **CSS** — read `src/global.css` else `src/app.css`; `stripTailwindDirectives`
    (uses compiler `cssBlockEnd`) → `static/global.css`; run `plugin.onCSS`
    chain on the raw css → `static/_tailwind.css`.
15. If `options.ssg` → `generateSsgRoutes(routeTree, appDir, outDir)` →
    `prerendered/*.html`, collect `prerenderedRoutes`.
16. `optimizeImages(appDir, outDir)` → `static/images/*` (currently invoked
    twice — see §6).
17. If `options.seo` → `runSeoAudit(appDir)`; if `options.strictSeo` and
    `audit.errors > 0` → `throw`.
18. Sitemap/robots: `generateSitemap(routeTree, ssrRoutes, prerenderedRoutes,
    { siteUrl: options.siteUrl })` → `static/public/sitemap.xml`;
    `generateRobotsTxt(siteUrl)` → `static/public/robots.txt` — both skipped if
    a user file already exists at the target.
19. `generateManifest(routeTree, ssrRoutes, apiRoutes, prerenderedRoutes,
    middlewareEnabled, actionMap)` → write `config.json`.
20. **Platform** — `detectPlatform(options.platform ? ['--platform', options.platform] : [], process.env)`;
    if `'node'` and `options.target === 'edge'` → `'edge'`. If result ≠ `'node'`:
    `emitPlatformOutput(platform, { outDir, ssrRoutes, apiRoutes,
    prerenderedPaths, prerenderedRoutes, hasMiddleware: middlewareEnabled })`.
    For `vercel` also creates `.vercel/output` symlink (inside `emitPlatformOutput`).
21. Run every `plugin.onBuildEnd()` (awaited).
22. Return `{ routeTree, apiTree, ssrRoutes, apiRoutes, manifest }`.

**Server runtime exports produced by `bundleRuntime`** (used by generated
functions): `cookies`, `headers`, `locals`, `renderPage`, `renderFullPage`,
`renderPageStream`, `compileFile`, `parseCookies`, `VeskRequest`,
`VeskResponse`, `defineAction`, `getAction`, `clearActions`,
`validateActionInput`, `issuesToFieldMap`.


---

## 3. Client-bundle algorithms

### Code-split flow (`options.codeSplit === true`) — `generateClientBundle`
1. `walkSplit(routeTree, [])` — per route node, if the file exists, `compileFile`
   each of `page.vsk`, `layout.vsk`, `error.vsk`, `not-found.vsk`,
   `loading.vsk` into one chunk. Chunk name = `page-<slug>.js` where `<slug>` =
   `relative(appDir, sourceDir)` joined by `-` (empty → `index`), `[]`→`_`.
2. `compileFile(path, resolvedName, out)`:
   - recursively resolve `.vsk` imports via `resolveVskImports` →
     `collectVskImportPaths(vskImportLines(src), filePath)` then
     `resolveComponentName` on each imported file; recurse `compileFile`.
   - `compileClient(src, null, { forceClient: true })` → collect runtime
     imports (`collectRuntimeImports`), then strip runtime import lines
     (`stripRuntimeImport`), `.vsk` imports (`stripVskImports`), and export
     lines (`stripExports`).
   - `compileClient(src, null, { hydrate: true, forceClient: true,
     includeTopLevel: false })` → same, but `__components` →
     `__hydrators` (hydrator code).
   - if resolved name ≠ actual component name, emit `Object.defineProperty`
     aliases for both `__components` and `__hydrators`.
3. Shared `components/` map → `compileFile` each into a `shared.js` chunk
   (appended last).
4. Wrap each chunk in an IIFE that grabs `globalThis.__components` /
   `globalThis.__hydrators`.
5. Annotate `routeTree` nodes with `node.chunk = '/_vesk/static/page-<slug>.js'`
   when a non-empty chunk was emitted.
6. `buildMainBundle` (codeSplit variant) emits the `createFileRouter` bootstrap,
   a `__resolveNames` that records `_chunk`, `_pageName`, `_layoutName`,
   `_errorName`, `_notFoundName`, and a `__pendChunks` list derived from
   `matchRoute(__routeTree, location.pathname)`; then `Promise.all(
   __pendChunks.map(ensureChunk)).then(__startRouter)` (or start immediately).
   Router start calls `__updateComponents(__routeTree)` then
   `createFileRouter(...).start()`.

### Monolithic flow (`codeSplit` falsy)
`walkMono` compiles every route file (no per-route chunk split) into four arrays
(`componentLines`, `hydratorLines`, `aliasLines`, `hydratorAliasLines`), joined
into a single `main` bundle. `chunks` is empty.

### Tree-shaken runtime
- Base runtime names always required by `buildMainBundle`:
  `createFileRouter, get, set, effect, track, destroy_block, getActiveComponent,
  setActiveComponent, NavLink, Link, reactiveProps`.
- Additional names are collected from each compiled chunk's
  `import {...} from '@vesk/runtime'` (`collectRuntimeImports`).

- `buildTreeShakenRuntime(runtimeDir, usedNames)`:
  1. `unique = dedupe(usedNames)`; `available = runtimeExportNames(runtimeDir)`
     (parses `index-client.js` `export { ... } from`).
  2. If any requested name is missing → log + **fall back to
     `buildRuntimeCode`** (legacy concatenation; emits `// --- <file> ---`
     markers). Missing-name detection is what the tree-shake test exercises.
  3. Else write a temp entry re-exporting the names, `esbuild.build` as a
     browser IIFE `{ globalName: '__veskRuntime', treeShaking: true,
     minify: true }`, then append:
     `const { <names> } = __veskRuntime; export { <names> };`
  4. The IIFE's scope is closed → its internals can never collide with page
     code; only the explicitly re-exported names are ESM-visible.
- `importRuntime: true` bypasses inlining: `buildMainBundle` emits
  `import { <names> } from '/_vesk/runtime.js'` and sets `runtimeCode = ''`.
- HMR helper: `appendHmrGlobals` adds `globalThis.__vesk_hmr_eval = (code) =>
  eval(code)`.


---

## 4. Platform detection / emit

### Detection (`detectPlatform(args, env)`) — precedence
1. `--platform <name>` in `args` (lowercased, must be in `VALID`).
2. Env vars:
   - vercel: `VERCEL` | `VERCEL_ENV` | `NOW_REGION` | `VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA`
   - netlify: `NETLIFY` | `NETLIFY_BUILD_CONTEXT` | `NETLIFY_LOCAL` | `NETLIFY_EDGE`
   - cloudflare: `CF_PAGES` | `CF_PAGES_BRANCH` | `CF_PAGES_URL` |
     `CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS` | `WORKERS_NAME`
   - deno: `DENO_DEPLOYMENT_ID` | `DENO_REGION` | `DENO_DEPLOY_URL`
   - aws: `AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME` | `AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_VERSION` |
     `LAMBDA_TASK_ROOT` | `LAMBDA_RUNTIME_DIR`
   - coxmos: `COXMOS` | `COXMOS_DEPLOYMENT_ID` | `COXMOS_ENV` | `VESK_DEPLOY` |
     `VESK_PLATFORM === 'coxmos'`
3. Default `'node'`.

### Emission (`emitPlatformOutput(platform, ctx)`)
Returns `null` for `'node'`. Steps:
1. `generatePlatformHandlerSource({ ssrRoutes, apiRoutes, prerenderedPaths,
   hasMiddleware })` — universal handler; each SSR/API fn imported from
   `./server/functions/<name>.js` / `./server/api/<name>.js` as
   `import { handle as __ssr_<id> }`. Includes `__prerendered` Set,
   `__isrCache` Map, `__matchPath`, `__routes`, ISR revalidation, 404 fallback,
   and prerendered 308 redirects.
2. `shellFor(platform)` — per-platform shell (see map below).
3. `writePlatformStatic` + `writePrerenderedStatic` → platform `static/`.
4. Compose entry: `handler` + optional `imports` + optional embedded-statics
   source (`denoStaticSource` / `nodeStaticSource` / `inlineStaticSource`) +
   `bootstrap`.
5. `bundlePlatformHandler({ entry, outfile, nodeBuiltins })` — esbuild ESM
   bundle; when `nodeBuiltins` is false, a plugin replaces node builtins with
   an empty Proxy shim.
6. Write `.vc-config.json` (vercel), `config.json` (vercel routes),
   `manifest.json` (always), and `extraFiles`.
7. Vercel: create `.vercel/output` symlink → `.vesk/vercel`.

Platform → shell map (`shellFor`):
| platform | root | nodeBuiltins | staticMode | staticServe | bundle out |
|----------|------|--------------|------------|-------------|------------|
| vercel | `.vesk/vercel` | true | platform | – | `functions/__index.func/index.js` |
| netlify | `.vesk/netlify` | true | platform | – | `functions/__index.js` |
| cloudflare | `.vesk/cloudflare` | false | platform | – | `_worker.js` |
| deno | `.vesk/deno` | false | embedded | disk-deno | `index.js` |
| coxmos | `.vesk/coxmos` | false | embedded | disk-deno | `index.js` |
| aws | `.vesk/aws` | true | embedded | disk-node | `index.mjs` (+ `template.yaml`) |
| edge | `.vesk/edge` | false | embedded | inline | `index.js` |
| (node) | – | – | – | – | none (returns null) |

Static layout mapping (`writePlatformStatic`):
- `/_vesk/static/*`  ←  `.vesk/static/*`
- `/_vesk/runtime.js` ← `.vesk/static/client.js` (alias copy)
- `/*` (public)      ←  `.vesk/static/public/*`


---

## 5. Cross-module dependencies

- **`@vesk/compiler`** (imported across many files):
  - `scan.ts` → `cssBlockEnd` (index.ts CSS stripping)
  - `router.js` → `scanRoutes`, `scanComponents` (index.ts, dev-server.ts);
    `extractMiddlewareParts` (middleware.ts)
  - `api-routes.js` → `scanApiRoutes` (index.ts)
  - `middleware.js` → `collectMiddlewareChain` (index.ts)
  - `actions.js` → `collectActionIds` (index.ts)
  - `client-codegen.js` → `compileClient` (client-bundle.ts, hmr.ts)
  - `server-codegen.js` → `resolveComponentName` (ssr-function.ts,
    client-bundle.ts, hmr.ts, prod-server.ts), `createRateLimiter` (prod-server.ts)
  - `vsk-imports.js` → `collectVskImportPaths`, `vskImportLines` (client-bundle.ts)
  - `server-render.js` → `ssg` (static.ts)
  - `server-cookies.js` → `parseCookies` (bundled by runtime-bundle.ts,
    platform-handler.ts)
  - `server-utils.js` → `securityHeaders`, `getClientProtocol` (prod-server.ts)
- **`@vesk/runtime`** — server: `src/index-server.js` (runtime-bundle,
  prod-server, CLI); client: `dist/index-client.js` + module files
  (client-bundle, dev-server, hmr tests). `client-bundle` bundles runtime `.js`
  sources from `runtime/dist` (searched via `findRuntimeSrc`).
- **Third-party**: `esbuild` (bundling/transform), `sharp` (images, optional),
  `ws` (`WebSocketServer`, hmr), `typescript` (dev-only `transpile`),
  `node:fs`, `node:path`, `node:http`, `node:module`, `node:url`.
- **CLI integration** (`packages/cli/src/index.ts`): imports `build,
  startProdServer` from `@vesk/adapter/src/index`, `runSeoAudit` from
  `@vesk/adapter/src/seo-audit`; and `packages/cli/src/dev-server.ts` imports
  `generateClientBundle, buildTreeShakenRuntime, runtimeExportNames` from
  `@vesk/adapter/src/client-bundle`. So changing those signatures breaks the CLI.


---

## 6. Test inventory

All tests live in `src/*.test.ts` (plain scripts, no framework; they print a
tally and `process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0)`).

| Test file | Coverage | Requires browser? |
|-----------|----------|-------------------|
| `seo-audit.test.ts` | `runSeoAudit` result counts; validates h1, alt, Image alt, OG, heading-order, layout-contributed head props. | No |
| `tree-shake.test.ts` | `buildTreeShakenRuntime` + `runtimeExportNames`: IIFE present, explicit `export {};` emitted, unused modules dropped, clean ESM import with exactly the requested exports, >100-name dev set, legacy concat fallback on missing name. | No |
| `hmr.test.ts` | `startDevServer` + WebSocket at `/_vesk/hmr`: `compiling`/`update`/`error` messages, `fnSources`, standalone component create/update, client + hmr-client content. Uses `test/fixtures/hmr-app` and a live dev server. | Dev server only |
| `hydration.test.ts` | `build` + `startProdServer` + puppeteer-core: initial render, reactivity, dynamic route, no JS errors, hydration strategy exports on `/_vesk/runtime.js` (hydrateViewport/idle/onInteraction/collectVskMarkers/createHydrateWalker), all markers claimed. | Yes (puppeteer-core) |
| `code-split.test.ts` | `build(..., { codeSplit: true })` + `startProdServer` + puppeteer-core: main bundle loads, `page-about` script injected on nav, direct nav, slug route, chunk caching on SPA revisit, lazy registration, no JS errors. | Yes (puppeteer-core) |

Env gates: `VESK_E2E` (skip the build/server-start phase and reuse a running
server), `VESK_E2E_PROD_PORT` (default `3099`), `VESK_E2E_DEV_PORT` (default
`3002`). Puppeteer uses hardcoded Chromium
`/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/chromium-browser`.

**Run commands:**
- `npx tsx packages/adapter/src/seo-audit.test.ts`
- `npx tsx packages/adapter/src/tree-shake.test.ts`
- `npx tsx packages/adapter/src/hmr.test.ts`
- `npx tsx packages/adapter/src/hydration.test.ts`
- `npx tsx packages/adapter/src/code-split.test.ts`
- Precondition for E2E: `npx tsx packages/cli/src/build-packages.ts` (builds
  `compiler/dist` + `runtime/dist`).
- Typecheck: `npm run typecheck`; build: `npm run build`.


---

## 7. "If modifying X, update Y" checklist

- **SSR function output shape / `server/functions/*.js`** (`ssr-function.ts`,
  `hmr.ts:regenerateSsrFunction`) → keep `export async function handle(request)`;
  prod-server (`loadFunction` → `mod.handle`) and platform-handler
  (`import { handle }`) both depend on it.
- **API function output shape / `server/api/*.js`** (`api-function.ts`) → keep
  `export async function handle(request)` (prod-server + platform-handler use
  it). `@vesk/runtime` import rewrite must keep resolving to `../runtime.js`.
- **`server/runtime.js` exports** (`runtime-bundle.ts`) → prod-server,
  ssr-function, api-function, and generated fn code import from it; add any new
  export here if generated code should use it.
- **Client runtime names** (`client-bundle.ts:buildTreeShakenRuntime` /
  `buildMainBundle` base list) → if you add a runtime export your components
  can use, add it to the base list + `collectRuntimeImports` must pick it up;
  update `tree-shake.test.ts`; the CLI (`packages/cli/src/dev-server.ts`)
  imports `buildTreeShakenRuntime`/`runtimeExportNames`.
- **Code-split chunk naming** (`buildChunkName` → `page-<slug>.js`) → update
  `code-split.test.ts` assertions (`page-about` etc.).
- **`config.json` schema** (`manifest.ts` + `types.ts Manifest`) → update
  `prod-server.ts` (`BuildConfig` parse) and `dev-server.ts` route lookups.
- **Middleware chain** (`middleware.ts`) → both variants
  (`compileMiddleware` export `execute`, `compileMiddlewareCode` inline
  `__executeMw`) must stay in sync; prod-server imports `server/middleware.js`
  `execute`; platform-handler imports `./server/middleware.js` `execute`.
- **Platform detection** (`platform.ts`) → a new platform must be added to the
  `Platform` union (types.ts `BuildOptions.platform`), `VALID`, `detectPlatform`
  env branch, AND `shellFor` in `platform-deploy.ts`, else it throws
  `Unsupported platform`.
- **Platform static layout** (`platform-output.ts`) → `writePlatformStatic` /
  `writePrerenderedStatic` map URLs that both the SSR output and each
  `staticServe` (disk-deno/node/inline) rely on; keep the `/_vesk/static/*`
  scheme in sync.
- **SEO checks** (`seo-audit.ts` `SEO_CHECKS`) → update `seo-audit.test.ts`
  expectations if you add/remove a check's severity.
- **build() stage order / flags** (`index.ts`) → keep `BuildOptions` + the CLI
  opts (`packages/cli/src/index.ts`) in sync (`seo`, `strictSeo`, `codeSplit`,
  `platform`, `target`, `ssg`).
- **Image pipeline** (`image-pipeline.ts`) → `ImageResult`/`ImageRef` types in
  types.ts must match; the `optimizeImages` double-call in index.ts is a known
  observation — if you move it, keep both call sites or document the change.
